_comment: Vocalization configurations ('speech patterns') for the AI customer's voice.
Two options for every Gender x Age Range combination, so a scenario can be given
a voice that fits its persona and can be A/B compared.
Age ranges are half-open [min, max): age 40 resolves to 'mid', age 55 to 'senior'.
Azure does not label voices by age, so age fit is a curated judgement - approximated
by voice timbre plus a light prosody nudge, not a service capability.
ALL voices are DragonHD, the highest-fidelity tier. That means no styles: DragonHD
advertises none and silently ignores mstts:express-as, so supports_styles is false
everywhere and validation rejects any profile that sets a style. Character comes from
the voice and the reply text instead.
earlier -14%/-8% settings on the 55+ profiles fought it and read as droning.
Credentials are env var NAMES, never values, so each profile can point at its own
key/region/endpoint without secrets entering this file.
Rate runs +5% to +10%. DragonHD ignores mstts:silence - the punctuation-pause
controls - so rate is the only lever over pause length, and it scales the pauses
with the speech. Pitch stays within +/-5%, where the earlier -8% read as droning.

defaults._output_format_note: SDK enum name, applied by getSynthesizer in app.js. The previous value was a REST header string that nothing read, so synthesis fell back to the SDK default of 48 kbit/s - the lowest MP3 tier. 160 kbit/s measured at 3.4x the bytes for the same 4s clip.

profiles.label: Friendly, conversational
profiles.notes: The DragonHD build of the same voice family as the old standard-neural option.

profiles.label: Measured and composed
profiles.notes: Default 40-55 female. No prosody override at all.

profiles.label: Direct, time-pressed
profiles.notes: Crisper delivery carries the time-pressed read that a style tag used to.

profiles.label: Cautious, deliberate
profiles.notes: A distinct voice rather than the same one slowed further. Was Jenny at -12%/-6%.

profiles.label: Blunt, fast
profiles.notes: DragonHD build of the previous standard-neural voice. Was +8%.

profiles.label: Sceptical value buyer
profiles.notes: Guarded read from the voice itself; the mild unfriendly style is gone.

profiles.label: Wary, slow to commit
profiles.notes: A distinct voice instead of Guy at -14%/-8%, which was the most overdriven setting.
